title: A Repeated Digit
statement: How many four-digit numbers (from $1000$ to $9999$) have at least one repeated digit?
insight: Count the complement: four-digit numbers with all digits distinct are 9·9·8·7.
redHerring: Casework on which positions repeat and how many times.
hints: 'At least one' is often easier through its opposite.
Count four-digit numbers with all distinct digits.
solution: All-distinct four-digit numbers: $9\cdot9\cdot8\cdot7 = 4536$. Total four-digit numbers: $9000$. So $9000 - 4536 = 4464$ have a repeat.
